$comment: The wire-contract drift task U0.1 deliberately left behind, and the exact
set of test files it left failing. Read scripts/known-drift-gate.mjs for
how this file is used; read it before adding an entry.
Task U0.1 (2026-08-31, commit 6bf58f0) re-sourced wui/contract/ from
published Core v0.7.0 sessionwire/v1 -- 33 schemas, 33 fixtures -- and
removed Harness from the module graph. @looprig/protocol's TypeScript
schema mirror still describes the Harness-era wire contract, so it
disagrees with the newly mirrored Core contract. The Wave 2 checkpoint
permits that drift; reconciling it is Wave 4C protocol work and is blocked
on Factory contract fixtures that do not exist yet.
This is an allowance for a KNOWN, DATED, BOUNDED failure, not a way to
stop running the suite. Every test in every one of these files still runs
in CI. The gate fails if any file NOT listed here fails, and it fails if a
file listed here stops failing -- retiring an entry is a deliberate edit in
the same commit that fixes the drift.
File granularity, not failure counts: three of these files drive real HTTP
servers with timeouts, so their failure counts are machine-dependent and a
recorded count would make CI flaky rather than strict.
reason: U0.1 Core sessionwire/v1 re-source; reconciliation is Wave 4C protocol work, blocked on Factory contract fixtures
